realm_description: The beating civic center of every continent — capitals, universities, and Guild Headquarters all rise here. This is where community becomes something larger than any one person.

primary.label: Farmer
primary.description: Understands greatness is built on unglamorous, repeated care; trusts slow effort over sudden force.
primary.guiding_promise: I will tend what grows slowly, trusting the harvest will come.
primary.shadow_description: Mistakes 'give it time' for permission to never intervene, even as something dies.

secondary.label: Aristocrat
secondary.description: Leads with inherited certainty and intuitive command.
secondary.guiding_promise: I carry the weight of legacy and lead with the confidence it bestows.
secondary.shadow_description: Mistakes inherited certainty for earned worth, and dismisses anyone without the pedigree to match.

wheel.central_question: Should we control every detail until it's perfect, or trust a process we can't fully control?

growth.label: Aristocrat
growth.description: Leads with inherited certainty and intuitive command.
growth.guiding_promise: I carry the weight of legacy and lead with the confidence it bestows.
growth.shadow_description: Mistakes inherited certainty for earned worth, and dismisses anyone without the pedigree to match.

other_ally.label: Messenger
other_ally.description: Bridges people and truths that wouldn't otherwise connect.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I carry only what is real, to those who need it most.
other_ally.shadow_description: Carries everyone else's message so faithfully that their own voice goes quiet.

quarter.label: Artisan
quarter.description: Pursues mastery and craft; decisions come from trained instinct.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will give every task the full weight of my ability.
quarter.shadow_description: Refuses to call the work finished, and refuses anyone else's hands on it either.

opposite.label: Craftsman
opposite.description: Believes excellence lives in the smallest details; discipline borders on devotion.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will refine this until it is right, no matter how long that takes.
opposite.shadow_description: Keeps refining what was already good enough, and calls the compulsion discipline.

realmmate.label: Democrat
realmmate.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
realmmate.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

wheel.compatible_text: Democrat · Bureaucrat — fellow travelers of The Living Heart.
